```{r}
# Gene list based on Pedram Razavi et.al. 2018
# if all samples are NEUT → NEUT
# if some samples show gain-side calls and some show loss-side calls for the same gene → MIXED
# otherwise collapse to the strongest state:
# HLAMP > AMP > GAIN
# HOMD > HETD

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# ===============================
# Path
# ===============================
clinical_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/AURORA/Clinical_data/Metasheet_Analysis.xlsx"

# ===============================
# Read file
# ===============================
clinical_df <- read_excel(clinical_file)

# ===============================
# Keep only needed columns
# ===============================
df <- clinical_df %>%
  mutate(
    Sample_ID = as.character(Collaborator_sample_id),
    Molecular_subtype = as.character(Molecular_subtype),
    Histological_subtype = as.character(Histological_subtype)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sample_ID = str_trim(Sample_ID),
    Molecular_subtype = str_trim(Molecular_subtype),
    Histological_subtype = str_trim(Histological_subtype)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Sample_ID), Sample_ID != "") %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract middle token as case ID
    Case_ID = sub("^[^-]+-([^-]+)-.*$", "\\1", Sample_ID)
  )
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(readxl)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

# ===============================
# Paths
# ===============================
cnr_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/AURORA/CNVKit/Annotated_cnr_file"
clinical_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/AURORA/Clinical_data/Metasheet_Analysis.xlsx"

# ===============================
# Genes of interest
# ===============================
genes_of_interest <- c(
  "ERBB2", "FGFR1", "NF1", "GNAS", "PAK1", "PIK3CA", "PTEN",
  "AKT1", "GATA3", "ESR1", "FOXA1", "KMT2C", "ARID1A", "TBX3",
  "MYC", "MCL1", "MAP3K1", "RECQL4", "RARA", "CCND1", "CDH1", "TP53"
)

# ===============================
# Helper functions
# ===============================

# Collapse multiple segment-level calls within one sample-gene
collapse_sample_gene <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(na.omit(x))
  if (length(x) == 0) return("NEUT")
  if (all(x == "NEUT")) return("NEUT")

  gain_states <- c("GAIN", "AMP", "HLAMP")
  loss_states <- c("HETD", "HOMD")

  # same sample/gene contains both gain-side and loss-side events
  if (any(x %in% gain_states) & any(x %in% loss_states)) return("MIXED")

  if ("HLAMP" %in% x) return("HLAMP")
  if ("AMP"   %in% x) return("AMP")
  if ("GAIN"  %in% x) return("GAIN")
  if ("HOMD"  %in% x) return("HOMD")
  if ("HETD"  %in% x) return("HETD")
  return("NEUT")
}

# Collapse multiple samples within one case-gene
collapse_case_gene <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(na.omit(x))
  if (length(x) == 0) return("NEUT")
  if (all(x == "NEUT")) return("NEUT")

  gain_states <- c("GAIN", "AMP", "HLAMP")
  loss_states <- c("HETD", "HOMD")

  if (any(x %in% gain_states) & any(x %in% loss_states)) return("MIXED")
  if ("MIXED" %in% x) return("MIXED")

  if ("HLAMP" %in% x) return("HLAMP")
  if ("AMP"   %in% x) return("AMP")
  if ("GAIN"  %in% x) return("GAIN")
  if ("HOMD"  %in% x) return("HOMD")
  if ("HETD"  %in% x) return("HETD")
  return("NEUT")
}

```

```{r}
# Collapse case-level subtype
collapse_case_subtype <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(na.omit(x))
  x <- x[x != ""]
  if (length(x) == 0) return("Unknown")
  if (length(x) == 1) return(x)
  # if multiple subtype labels within same case
  return("Unknown")
}

# Collapse case-level histology
collapse_case_histology <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(na.omit(x))
  x <- x[x != ""]
  if (length(x) == 0) return("other")
  if (length(x) == 1) return(x)
  # if multiple histology labels within same case
  return("other")
}

# ===============================
# Read all annotated CNR files
# ===============================
cnr_files <- list.files(
  path = cnr_dir,
  pattern = "\\.annotated\\.cnr$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat("Total CNR files:", length(cnr_files), "\n")

read_one_cnr <- function(f) {
  dt <- fread(f)

  sample_name <- basename(f) %>%
    str_remove("\\.annotated\\.cnr$")

  case_id <- sub("-.*", "", sample_name)

  corrected_call_col <- grep("\\.Corrected_Call$", names(dt), value = TRUE)
  if (length(corrected_call_col) == 0) return(NULL)

  dt %>%
    transmute(
      Sample = sample_name,
      Case = case_id,
      gene = gene,
      Corrected_Call = as.character(.data[[corrected_call_col[1]]])
    )
}

all_cnr <- map_dfr(cnr_files, read_one_cnr)
```

```{r}
# ===============================
# Check case-level CNV presence
# ===============================
sample_status <- all_cnr %>%
  group_by(Sample, Case) %>%
  summarise(
    has_CNV = any(!is.na(Corrected_Call) & Corrected_Call != "NEUT"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

case_status <- sample_status %>%
  group_by(Case) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    has_CNV = any(has_CNV),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("Total cases:", nrow(case_status), "\n")
cat("Cases with CNV:", sum(case_status$has_CNV), "\n")
cat("Cases with NO CNV:", sum(!case_status$has_CNV), "\n")

neutral_cases <- case_status %>%
  filter(!has_CNV) %>%
  pull(Case)

cat("Excluding globally CNV-neutral cases:", paste(neutral_cases, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# exclude AO92, APID, AQ3V
all_cnr <- all_cnr %>%
  filter(!Case %in% neutral_cases)

```
```{r}
# ===============================
# Keep only genes of interest
# gene column may contain multiple comma-separated genes
# ===============================
cnr_long <- all_cnr %>%
  separate_rows(gene, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(
    gene = str_trim(gene),
    Corrected_Call = str_trim(Corrected_Call)
  ) %>%
  filter(gene %in% genes_of_interest)

# ===============================
# Collapse segment -> sample-gene
# ===============================
sample_gene_calls <- cnr_long %>%
  group_by(Sample, Case, gene) %>%
  summarise(
    Call = collapse_sample_gene(Corrected_Call),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ===============================
# Collapse sample -> case-gene
# ===============================
case_gene_calls <- sample_gene_calls %>%
  group_by(Case, gene) %>%
  summarise(
    Call = collapse_case_gene(Call),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Fill missing Case-gene combinations with NEUT
case_gene_calls <- expand.grid(
  Case = unique(case_gene_calls$Case),
  gene = genes_of_interest,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  left_join(case_gene_calls, by = c("Case", "gene")) %>%
  mutate(Call = ifelse(is.na(Call), "NEUT", Call))

```

```{r}
# ===============================
# Read clinical data
# ===============================
clinical_df <- read_excel(clinical_file)

clinical_case <- clinical_df %>%
  mutate(
    Collaborator_sample_id = as.character(Collaborator_sample_id),
    Molecular_subtype = as.character(Molecular_subtype),
    Histological_subtype = as.character(Histological_subtype)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Collaborator_sample_id = str_trim(Collaborator_sample_id),
    Molecular_subtype = str_trim(Molecular_subtype),
    Histological_subtype = str_trim(Histological_subtype),

    # Example: AUP-AL1Y-NB1 -> AL1Y
    Case = sub("^[^-]+-([^-]+)-.*$", "\\1", Collaborator_sample_id),

    Subtype_group = case_when(
      Molecular_subtype == "HR+HER2-" ~ "HR+/HER2−",
      Molecular_subtype == "HR+HER2+" ~ "HR+/HER2+",
      Molecular_subtype == "HR-HER2+" ~ "HR−/HER2+",
      Molecular_subtype == "TNBC"     ~ "TNBC",
      TRUE                            ~ "Unknown"
    ),

    Histology_group = case_when(
      Histological_subtype == "NST" ~ "ductal",
      Histological_subtype == "ILC" ~ "lobular",
      Histological_subtype %in% c("Other", "Unknown") ~ "other",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    )
  )

# Collapse clinical annotations to case level
case_clinical <- clinical_case %>%
  group_by(Case) %>%
  summarise(
    Subtype_group = collapse_case_subtype(Subtype_group),
    Histology_group = collapse_case_histology(Histology_group),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Merge clinical annotations
case_gene_calls <- case_gene_calls %>%
  left_join(case_clinical, by = "Case") %>%
  mutate(
    Subtype_group = ifelse(is.na(Subtype_group), "Unknown", Subtype_group),
    Histology_group = ifelse(is.na(Histology_group), "other", Histology_group)
  )

# Order of subtype panels
subtype_levels <- c("HR+/HER2−", "HR+/HER2+", "HR−/HER2+", "TNBC", "Unknown")
```

```{r}
# ===============================
# Colors
# ===============================
alter_col <- c(
  "HLAMP" = "#FF9933",
  "AMP"   = "#FFCC66",
  "GAIN"  = "#FFEE99",
  "HETD"  = "#A6BDDB",
  "HOMD"  = "#2166AC",
  "MIXED" = "#6A3D9A"
)

histology_col <- c(
  "ductal" = "#0000FF",
  "lobular" = "#FF0000",
  "other" = "grey70"
)

alter_fun <- list(
  background = function(x, y, w, h) {
    grid.rect(x, y, w * 0.95, h * 0.95,
              gp = gpar(fill = "white", col = "grey90"))
  },
  HLAMP = function(x, y, w, h) {
    grid.rect(x, y, w * 0.95, h * 0.95,
              gp = gpar(fill = alter_col["HLAMP"], col = NA))
  },
  AMP = function(x, y, w, h) {
    grid.rect(x, y, w * 0.95, h * 0.95,
              gp = gpar(fill = alter_col["AMP"], col = NA))
  },
  GAIN = function(x, y, w, h) {
    grid.rect(x, y, w * 0.95, h * 0.95,
              gp = gpar(fill = alter_col["GAIN"], col = NA))
  },
  HETD = function(x, y, w, h) {
    grid.rect(x, y, w * 0.95, h * 0.95,
              gp = gpar(fill = alter_col["HETD"], col = NA))
  },
  HOMD = function(x, y, w, h) {
    grid.rect(x, y, w * 0.95, h * 0.95,
              gp = gpar(fill = alter_col["HOMD"], col = NA))
  },
  MIXED = function(x, y, w, h) {
    grid.rect(x, y, w * 0.95, h * 0.95,
              gp = gpar(fill = alter_col["MIXED"], col = NA))
  }
)
```

```{r}
# ===============================
# Function to make one case-wise subtype oncoprint
# ===============================
make_oncoprint_by_subtype <- function(subtype_name, case_gene_calls, genes_of_interest) {

  sub_df <- case_gene_calls %>%
    filter(Subtype_group == subtype_name)

  if (nrow(sub_df) == 0) {
    cat("No cases found for subtype:", subtype_name, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  case_anno <- sub_df %>%
    distinct(Case, Histology_group)

  # matrix: rows = genes, columns = cases
  mat_df <- sub_df %>%
    select(Case, gene, Call) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Case, values_from = Call)

  mat <- as.matrix(mat_df[, -1, drop = FALSE])
  rownames(mat) <- mat_df$gene

  # preserve requested gene order
  mat <- mat[genes_of_interest, , drop = FALSE]

  # order cases by number of altered genes
  altered_per_case <- apply(mat, 2, function(x) sum(x != "NEUT"))
  case_order <- names(sort(altered_per_case, decreasing = TRUE))
  mat <- mat[, case_order, drop = FALSE]

  case_anno <- case_anno %>%
    mutate(Case = factor(Case, levels = case_order)) %>%
    arrange(Case)

  # Convert NEUT to blank for oncoPrint
  mat_for_onco <- mat
  mat_for_onco[mat_for_onco == "NEUT"] <- ""

  top_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Histology = case_anno$Histology_group,
    col = list(Histology = histology_col),
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
  )

  ht <- oncoPrint(
    mat_for_onco,
    alter_fun = alter_fun,
    alter_fun_is_vectorized = FALSE,
    col = alter_col,
    top_annotation = top_ha,
    show_column_names = TRUE,
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    show_row_names = TRUE,
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    column_title = paste0(subtype_name, " (n = ", ncol(mat_for_onco), ")"),
    pct_side = "left",      # avoid conflict
    pct_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    show_pct = TRUE,
    remove_empty_rows = FALSE,
    remove_empty_columns = FALSE,
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "CNV",
      at = c("HLAMP", "AMP", "GAIN", "HETD", "HOMD", "MIXED"),
      labels = c("HLAMP", "AMP", "GAIN", "HETD", "HOMD", "MIXED")
    )
  )

  return(ht)
}
draw(ht)
```
```{r}
# ===============================
# Create output folder
# ===============================
outdir <- "Comparision_Subtype"   # use "Comparison_Subtype" if you prefer
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) {
  dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# ===============================
# Save each subtype separately
# ===============================
for (st in subtype_levels) {
  ht <- make_oncoprint_by_subtype(st, case_gene_calls, genes_of_interest)
  if (is.null(ht)) next

  safe_name <- st %>%
    str_replace_all("\\+", "plus") %>%
    str_replace_all("−|-", "minus") %>%
    str_replace_all("/", "_")

  # PDF
  pdf(
    file = file.path(outdir, paste0("CNV_oncoprint_casewise_", safe_name, ".pdf")),
    width = 16, height = 6
  )
  draw(ht)
  dev.off()

  # PNG
  png(
    filename = file.path(outdir, paste0("CNV_oncoprint_casewise_", safe_name, ".png")),
    width = 16, height = 6, units = "in", res = 300
  )
  draw(ht)
  dev.off()
}
```
